blessing.ask: you to join us in the wedding celebrations of

config.message: Thank you for being part of our story. Every call, every blessing and every piece of advice since our engagement has meant more to us than we can say. Our wedding would not feel complete without you, so come to the sea, dance with us and stay for the sunset.

photos.alt: The couple under a veil at sunset
He lifts her in a spin on the beach
Walking hand in hand along the shore
Running across the sand toward the sea

rsvp.text: Hello! I would love to join Joel and Anna's wedding.

know.lead: A few small details to help you settle in and enjoy every moment of the celebrations.

items.title: Hashtag
items.text: Share your photos with #JoelAndAnna so we can find every one of them.

items.title: Weather
items.text: Expect warm, clear days around 31°C and a soft breeze by the sea at night.

items.title: Staff
items.text: Rooms for your drivers and staff are available at a lodge close to the venue.

items.title: Parking
items.text: Valet parking is available for all our guests at the venue.

config.closing: Our families are so happy you can be with us. We cannot wait to celebrate with you by the sea.
